# table-column-count

- ID: `MD056`
- Category: Tables
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `table`

Every table row has as many cells as the header row.

## Why

Renderers drop extra cells, so their data is lost. Missing cells render empty
and look like an omission.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix. Only the author knows which cells are missing or
extra.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `table-column-count: false` turns the rule off and
`table-column-count: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable table-column-count` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line table-column-count -->
```
